system.history:
A researcher, laboratory specialist, field analyst, or technical consultant with expertise chosen to suit the scene.

Scene use: Explains a phenomenon, operates specialized equipment, becomes a rescue objective, or reveals the consequences of an experiment.
system.personality: Analytical and absorbed by difficult questions. Decide whether caution, discovery, recognition, or responsibility drives their choices.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Protective coat or field gear, identification badge, tablet, sample case, or specialized instruments.

system.description: An improvised close defense using a case, tool, or piece of laboratory equipment.
